name: Dongkuyuyan
source:
CaveFiction is a "game" developed by an individual. I, the author, call "it" a game. But in essence, "it" is a freak born from the sad, arrogant, and stupid author's consciousness. "It" takes its name from a classic metaphor in Plato's classical philosophy, so "it" is also a manic modern story within the framework of a classical narrative.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955490/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
CaveFiction是一款由个人开发的“游戏”。我，作者，把“它”称作游戏。但从本质上说，“它”是这位悲伤、自负又愚蠢的作者意识所孕育出的怪胎。

“它”的名字取自柏拉图古典哲学中的经典隐喻——洞穴寓言；因此，“它”也是一则以古典叙事为框架的狂热现代故事。

[译自：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955490/]Steam[/url]]
